headline: Daily market snapshot — August 19, 2026
summary: US equity futures rising Wednesday as markets await FOMC July minutes at 2pm ET; S&P 500 closed 7,691.76 (-0.69%) and Nasdaq 26,289.71 (-1.33%) on Tuesday. 30-year Treasury yield eased to ~5.28% after hitting 19-year intraday high of 5.34% on Monday. headline: Trump says no Iran talks planned; Tehran says Strait of Hormuz remains shut as MoU expires
summary: The 60-day US-Iran memorandum of understanding expired Monday, with President Trump stating no negotiations are underway or scheduled. A senior Iranian official said Iran is moving to a 'fully offensive' military posture, while Iran demands the US lift oil sanctions and end military threats before reopening the Strait of Hormuz. The UAE separately detected a missile threat.

headline: 30-year Treasury yield tops 5.33%, reaching highest level since 2007, on inflation and spending concerns
summary: The 30-year US Treasury yield hit 5.34% intraday on August 18, its highest level since 2007, before easing to 5.28%. The selloff reflects investor concern over surging government spending, a flood of long-dated bond sales, and persistent inflation driven in part by elevated oil prices from the Iran-Hormuz conflict. The move echoed across global bond markets with German 30-year bunds at 2011 highs and Canadian 30-year bonds at highest since 2010.
key_facts: 30-year UST yield hit 5.34% intraday — 19-year high since 2007
US fiscal deficit in July was highest monthly total since March 2021

headline: FOMC July 28-29 minutes due at 2pm ET on August 19 — markets watch for hawkish signals on September hike
summary: The Federal Reserve will release minutes from its July 28-29 FOMC meeting at 2pm ET. At that meeting the Fed held rates at 3.50-3.75% with three dissents — Presidents Logan, Hammack, and Kashkari all voted for a 25bp hike. Markets are watching whether the minutes reveal broader committee support for a September rate increase, with current odds placing a hold at ~65% probability.

headline: Three risks that could push 30-year Treasury yield even higher: oil inflation, fiscal deficit, supply glut

The 30-year yield hit a 19-year high of 5.34% on August 18.
